title: Who is who in The Interview
back: Silvester (Part I), the critics Kipling and Bellow (with Naipaul, Carroll, Wells), Padmanabhan (interviewer), Umberto Eco (interstices, narrative scholar, Name of the Rose).

title: The Interview in six beats
back: 130 years → critics → Brian's power → interstices → scholar who tells stories → The Name of the Rose.

title: Truth and art — or intrusion?
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Two views of the interview, 130 years on" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g transform="translate(90,120) scale(1.0)"><rect x="-14" y="-60" width="28" height="60" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none" rx="14"/><path d="M-24,-30 Q-24,10 0,10 Q24,10 24,-30" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M0,10 V34 M-16,34 H16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></g><g><circle cx="230" cy="87.1" r="12.1" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="none"/><path d="M213.5,107.19999999999999 Q230,99.19999999999999 246.5,107.19999999999999 L243.86,138.8 L236.6,138.8 L237.92,185 H231.65 L230.66,141.0 H229.34 L228.35,185 H222.08 L223.4,138.8 L216.14,138.8 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="none"/></g><path d="M150,70 L190,70" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="4 4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><text x="90" y="165" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">source of truth</text><text x="240" y="60" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">intrusion</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Two views of the interview, 130 years on</text></svg>
back: Some call it a source of truth and an art; its victims call it an intrusion that diminishes them, like a photograph stealing the soul.

title: Kipling's paradox
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="'Immoral, a crime, an assault' — then he interviewed Twain" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g><circle cx="100" cy="78.2" r="13.2" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.7" stroke="none"/><path d="M82.0,99.4 Q100,91.4 118.0,99.4 L115.12,134.6 L107.2,134.6 L108.64,185 H101.8 L100.72,137.0 H99.28 L98.2,185 H91.36 L92.8,134.6 L84.88,134.6 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.7" stroke="none"/><path d="M80.2,71.60000000000001 H119.8 V66.32000000000001 H111.88 V51.800000000000004 H88.12 V66.32000000000001 H80.2 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.7" stroke="none"/></g><g transform="translate(200,150) scale(0.8)"><rect x="-14" y="-60" width="28" height="60" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none" rx="14"/><path d="M-24,-30 Q-24,10 0,10 Q24,10 24,-30" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M0,10 V34 M-16,34 H16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></g><path d="M130,110 L180,110 M171.2,114.8 L180,110 L171.2,105.2" fill="none" stroke="#E0B400" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><text x="250" y="60" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Mark Twain</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">'Immoral, a crime, an assault' — then he interviewed Twain</text></svg>
back: Caroline Kipling's 1892 Boston diary records two reporters ruining a day. Kipling denounced the practice and practised it; Wells called it an ordeal and interviewed Stalin in 1934.

title: Thumbprints on the windpipe
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Saul Bellow on being interviewed" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><circle cx="160" cy="70" r="28" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><path d="M120,100 Q160,86 200,100 L210,170 H110 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><circle cx="145" cy="112" r="7" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none"/><circle cx="175" cy="112" r="7" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none"/><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Saul Bellow on being interviewed</text></svg>
back: The most vivid of the complaints — the feeling of being choked — from a writer who nevertheless consented several times.

title: Working in the interstices
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="While the visitor comes up in the lift, Eco writes" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="90" y="30" width="140" height="150" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" rx="6"/><rect x="100" y="40" width="120" height="130" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.12" stroke="none"/><path d="M160,160 L160,60 M164.8,68.8 L160,60 L155.2,68.8" fill="none" stroke="#E0B400" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><g><circle cx="40" cy="122.7" r="7.7" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><path d="M29.5,138.4 Q40,130.4 50.5,138.4 L48.82,155.6 L44.2,155.6 L45.04,185 H41.05 L40.42,157.0 H39.58 L38.95,185 H34.96 L35.8,155.6 L31.18,155.6 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/></g><path d="M230,175 Q245.0,169.0 260.0,175 Q275.0,169.0 290,175 V135 Q275.0,129.0 260.0,135 Q245.0,129.0 230,135 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none"/><path d="M260.0,175 V135" fill="none" stroke="#E0B400" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">While the visitor comes up in the lift, Eco writes</text></svg>
back: Interstices = the empty spaces of time. Remove the empty space from the universe and it shrinks to a fist; most of a day is empty too, and he fills it.

title: The story of the research
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="A professor praises what others hide: trials and errors" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><path d="M60,150 Q85.0,139.5 110.0,150 Q135.0,139.5 160,150 V80 Q135.0,69.5 110.0,80 Q85.0,69.5 60,80 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none"/><path d="M110.0,150 V80" fill="none" stroke="#E0B400" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M170,115 L220,115 M211.2,119.8 L220,115 L211.2,110.2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><g><circle cx="260" cy="96.0" r="11.0" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="none"/><path d="M245.0,115.0 Q260,107.0 275.0,115.0 L272.6,143.0 L266.0,143.0 L267.2,185 H261.5 L260.6,145.0 H259.4 L258.5,185 H252.8 L254.0,143.0 L247.4,143.0 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="none"/></g><text x="110" y="60" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none">age 22</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">A professor praises what others hide: trials and errors</text></svg>
back: At twenty-two Eco told the story of his research, false starts included; the professor published it. Since then he writes scholarship as narrative — and at fifty, novels, by accident.

title: 3,000 copies expected
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="A serious detective novel that sold millions" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="70" y="50" width="180" height="110" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none" rx="3"/><text x="160" y="95" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none">The Name</text><text x="160" y="115" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none">of the Rose</text><rect x="230" y="30" width="80" height="30" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25" stroke="none" rx="6"/><text x="270.0" y="48.5" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">10–15 million</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">A serious detective novel that sold millions</text></svg>
back: Metaphysics, theology and medieval history — hardly a bestseller. Eco calls the success a mystery: perhaps timing, and readers who want difficult experiences too.

title: How Eco sees himself
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Line to remember" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g><rect x="28" y="36" width="264" height="72" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.08" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" rx="10"/><path d="M50,108 L42,122 L64,108 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><text x="160.0" y="67.9" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">a professor who writes</text><text x="160.0" y="85.9" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">novels on Sundays</text></g><text x="160" y="146" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.8" stroke="none">— academic conferences, not Pen clubs</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Line to remember</text></svg>
back: Forty scholarly works against five novels: he identifies as an academic first, though he knows he will be remembered as a novelist.
